payload.entry: PLANNING EVIDENCE: On bob-cli 2f004d77, both sync execution branches rebuild pipeline_metadata and drop stable_metadata.source_markdown; the omission exists in 009060f9. The isolated bobs-org/bob checkout confirms 6beb2dad7 saved the source and d679d5151 created the only note revision without its pointer; source and PDF hashes still match the catalog exactly. A named attach-source dry run using the existing saved source verified 1 reference, skipped 0, writes none. No implementation or live-vault changes were made. A validated medium tale, sase_plan_ref_source_birth_pointer.md, covers pointer transfer, an intake invariant, regressions, doctor guidance, and the epic-required human repair gate; it is being submitted through sase plan propose.

Phase done (plugin_ignore=warn). Baseline: batch-15 115a3610 covered only the .bob-deploy.json stamp (refuse). Fix: new check_plugin_ignore() in src/native/plugins/deploy.rs reuses the stamp Git probes (git ls-files + check-ignore via vault_git) over the whole .obsidian/plugins/<id>/ folder + every managed file; warning (tracked/not_ignored/unknown) rides on PluginSync/PluginEntry as vault_ignore, printed under the row in sync + list tables (incl. dry-run and refusals) and in both JSON shapes; never blocks, never edits .gitignore, never untracks. Tests: 6 new maintained tests in src/native/plugins/tests.rs (non-Git clean, Git clean, unignored still syncs + JSON, tracked still syncs, dry-run carries warning w/o writing, list keeps columns + JSON). Gates: just check exit=0 (fmt+clippy+full tests), just docs-gen + docs-check exit=0, bob-plugins npm run docs:check exit=0. Docs: docs/plugins.md (Vault-ignore warnings section + JSON fields), docs/guides/deploy-obsidian-plugins.md, regenerated docs/reference/cli/plugins.md, bob-plugins docs/develop/deployment.md. Limitations: target task bob-cli-ch left open for the lander; changes in bob-cli checkout + linked bob-plugins checkout left uncommitted for the lander to commit via /sase_git_commit.

plugin-ignore-guard done per plugin_ignore=warn: folder-level git check-ignore/ls-files warnings in sync, list, dry-run, and both JSON shapes (vault_ignore), never blocking or editing .gitignore. Verified: just check exit=0 (fmt, clippy, full test suite incl. 6 new plugins ignore tests), just docs-gen + docs-check exit=0, bob-plugins docs:check exit=0. Target bob-cli-ch left open for the lander; no epic-symbol leftovers.

payload.entry:
Baseline 2f004d77. Annotated overwrite now uses one outer coordinate_explicit_pdf_move_with (live PDF -> preflighted archive PDF, ForMerging|ForMoving). Unannotated overwrites stay on merging write. move_annotated_bundle uses MoveContext::move_forward; immediate rollback uses InAccessorMoveReverseCoordinator (move_back, no-op before the forward move). Independent PlatformReverseCoordinator recovery uses a fresh coordinate_moving_write from archive to live, rechecks hashes inside the accessor, then deletes only a verified owned replacement. Feature enablement unchanged (default off). Never .forReplacing, never uncoordinated fallback.

Linux fake tests: 92 overwrite/file_coordination lib tests passed, including annotated success (one outer call, forward will/did), failpoint sweep (empty events before move; forward+inverse after), presenter-save abort before mutation, and platform reverse present/absent/changed-archive.

Native NSDocument tests added in macos_tests.rs (prefix archive_move_presenter_): merging+raw-rename unsafe control; notified forward follows archive and keeps replacement; in-accessor rollback restores live save target; merging-only reverse unsafe control; notified reverse restores live save target. They panic on CI if swiftc/login/presenter is missing; skip locally. Not executed on athena (Linux). Lander must check macOS CI job on the landed SHA, step "Run archive-move presenter cases": cargo test --locked --lib archive_move_presenter -- --nocapture --test-threads=1.

aarch64-apple-darwin clippy with stub CC/AR and CRATE_CC_NO_DEFAULTS=1 finished (type-check only, not a native build or runtime). just check, just docs-check, just check-scripts, and highlights_coordination_acceptance --self-test (13/13) passed. Real Highlights guided run remains unrun. bob-cli-d0 and ancestors left open.

Annotated overwrite archive moves and recovery now use one bounded ForMerging|ForMoving scope with will/did notifications. Linux: 92 overwrite/file_coordination lib tests, just check, docs-check, and acceptance --self-test 13/13 passed; aarch64-apple-darwin clippy with stub CC/AR is type-check only. Native archive_move_presenter_* NSDocument cases are in macos_tests.rs and CI (--nocapture) but were not run on athena; lander must confirm the macOS job on the landed SHA. Real Highlights guided run remains unrun. bob-cli-d0 left open.

LANDER ROLLOUT GATE: after the master re-sync and zero-drift check, and before declaring rollout verified, run the packaged startup smoke gate from the bob-plugins checkout: npm run smoke:obsidian -- --deployed-vault <vault> --report <report.json> (preceded by xvfb-run -a on Linux; offline-only self-test is npm run smoke:obsidian -- --self-test and is never an Obsidian pass). Executable prerequisite: the Obsidian Electron app (this run used /snap/bin/obsidian), an independent Xvfb display, Node 22; the runner fails unrun (exit 2) with exact rerun instructions when no host can launch Obsidian. Verdict on this phase: PASS on athena 2026-10-27 — layout-ready 438ms (budget 30s), heap peak 63MiB (budget 1.5GiB), relation ready with zero non-Markdown keys/reads and the fixture relation indexed, all four editor mounts ok (canonical daily + ordinary note x Live Preview + Source), zero exceptions/rejections/crash artifacts; offline suite 17/17, npm test 3831/3831, build:check/validate/docs:check green. Report reference: /tmp/obsidian-smoke.json from the passing run (ephemeral; rerunning the gate command regenerates it).

Delivered the packaged rollout smoke check plus docs and lander gate. Runner: scripts/obsidian-startup-smoke.cjs with lib scripts/obsidian-startup-smoke-lib.cjs and npm run smoke:obsidian; offline suite scripts/test-obsidian-startup-smoke.cjs (17/17) wired into npm test. Docs: rollout smoke gate section in bob-plugins docs/develop/deployment.md and bob-cli docs/guides/deploy-obsidian-plugins.md. Validation: offline 17/17, npm test 3831/3831, build:check, validate 8/8, docs:check 447 passed, just check green, plus a real isolated Athena Obsidian run: PASS (layout-ready 438ms, heap peak 63MiB, relation ready with zero non-Markdown keys/reads, 4/4 editors, zero exceptions/rejections/crashes). Lander gate recorded on this phase as LANDER ROLLOUT GATE. Leaving bob-cli-a6 and all ancestors open for the parent lander.

Fixed the bob-mac-capture build errors in PR #8 and merged as 0e7eba439a5c59b2fecc67917b8f36dcf479e2f1. Master CI run 40469875355 passed lint, Build, Test (3,184 tests, 0 failures; RefsPanelModelTests.testRetryableCoordinationRenameErrorsRetainDraftAndDoNotAnnounceSuccess passed), Bundle, plist/signature, launch smoke, and install/reinstall. PR check passed; epic-symbols reported no leftovers.

BASELINE: At 2f004d77, both v1/v2 sync executors rebuilt pipeline_metadata and dropped planned stable_metadata.source_markdown; the only new reference therefore lacked the pointer despite a verified saved source. CAUSE: execution metadata retained birth_lineage in v2 but omitted the parallel planned source pointer, and create intake did not enforce that a successfully saved Markdown source remained attached to the persisted note. FIX: preserve the planned pointer through both marker-write paths; propagate the verified saved-source expectation through create intake and reject/queue if the parsed persisted pointer is missing or differs; add doctor diagnostics and regressions. VERIFICATION: focused pointer/v1/v2 tests, store_ CLI tests, queued-create test, doctor diagnostics test, just check, and just docs-check all passed on the completed rerun (monitor 7v69tmjbxvfv, exit 0). An earlier run of store_ had two transient missing-note failures; the same full chain passed on rerun. REPAIR: custom gate custom-7255eeae-f6c8-4b06-83bf-38a0f7020088 approved one attach-source for muse_commentary_missing_from_exec_stream; preview/apply confirmed source SHA-256 ed2f4a29e3e3273f654f7c138daf7a8fe63c27cd68147419319245ca2f3777f8, PDF SHA-256 6b7e7234369e8afa77ec12c7994199d8a185ae8692f35196e7ff491e91c2e203, catalog SHA-256 391ce0e3b6dcf5eb1dd93658a4397ecc10426b534208aa62bf78c701a7619e5e; attached and committed b1d897724ac9ab55bb49f6c4a3830c895ae538df. POST-REPAIR: bob ref show -f json reports the exact source_markdown pointer and attached route; bob ref code reports available, 25,042-byte source with matching SHA and two blocks (Mermaid/JSON); bob ref links reports no_links; bob ref code -f markdown emits both blocks, --source SHA matches, and bob ref marker reads the PDF marker without writes. No unrepaired orphan or repair limitation remains.

Verified source-pointer implementation and all focused/full/docs checks; approved gate attached the byte-identical saved source to the exact orphan; Bob reads confirm pointer, source, code catalog, links, and Markdown access. No epic symbols remain. Closed this phase only; target task and ancestors remain open.
